subject: MTH101
experience: Honestly, this paper was unbelievably difficult. I have no idea who set this exam or what they were expecting from students. Almost nothing came from the handouts we studied, and many of the questions were written in such a confusing way that it was hard to even understand what was being asked. Instead of testing concepts, it felt like we were trying to decode the questions themselves. We spend weeks preparing from the provided material, but the exam was completely different. If the syllabus and handouts are supposed to guide our preparation, then the paper should reflect that. A challenging exam is acceptable, but an unnecessarily confusing one is not. It was frustrating from start to finish, and I genuinely feel this was one of the toughest and most poorly designed papers I've attempted.
